record.question: If R gets the most, V should be ranked not lower than
record.explanation: When R is first, T is seventh. V needs two lower places for P and Q; V can be fourth with P fifth and Q sixth. V cannot be fifth or lower without displacing T or one of P/Q. Fourth is the worst possible rank. Verified solution (unofficial); reviewed 26 October 2026.
record.direction: Directions (Question Nos. 48 - 50): Read the following information carefully and answer the questions that follow:
record.passage:
I. Seven boys P, Q, R, S, T, U and V take a series of tests.
II. V always scores more than P.
III. P always scores more than Q.
IV. No two boys get similar marks.
V. Each time either R scores the highest and T gets the least, or alternatively S scores the highest and U or Q scores the least.
